name: First five

sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: Front ribcage: back to Insurgence's own ribs, exactly as drawn, so it is rounded again. Its dark hollow down the middle is opened right through: the fire flickers in it and the spine shows behind. The gaps between the ribs are dark lines again, as in the original, not see-through. Back: the head is where official Charizard's is, forward and to the right, not perched on top of the spine. The spine now curves through the neck into the back of the skull and stops there; it no longer runs over the skull. The right wing rises from the right shoulder behind the neck. Look back seats the turned head on the same neck. The flickering fire and the slowly glowing eyes are as before.

note: Seventeenth look. Delta Charizard: Insurgence's rounded ribcage opened down the middle, and a back pose that follows Charizard's, with the spine curving into the back of the skull.
